channel.title: A Better Nerd is Possible: Art, Design, Health and Democracy
channel.itunes:author: Alice Jaggers and Avery Barrett
channel.description: Come hang out in our clubhouse! Alice and Avery have started a SUPER SECRET book club. Every month, we meet with a mission: explore art, design, health and democracy to find ways nerds can make the world a better place.
